package.description: Tool for capturing and analyzing logs produced by AudioCodes Session Border Controller (SBC), Media Gateway and IP Phone devices.

en-US.description: Tool for capturing and analyzing logs produced by AudioCodes Session Border Controller (SBC), Media Gateway and IP Phone devices.
en-US.longDescription:
Syslog Viewer utility can be used for two major tasks:
- Recording and displaying syslog messages from AudioCodes devices (SBC / Gateway / IP Phones)
- Analyzing recorded logs (including support for interactive SIP Flow Diagram)
en-US.name: AudioCodes Syslog Viewer

zh-CN.description: 用于捕获和分析 AudioCodes 会话边界控制器（SBC）、媒体网关和 IP 电话设备产生的日志的工具。
zh-CN.longDescription:
Syslog Viewer 工具主要用于以下两种任务：
- 记录并显示来自 AudioCodes 设备（SBC/网关/IP 电话）的系统日志信息
- 分析记录的日志（包括支持交互式 SIP 流程图）
